purpose: Teach: 賑わい/背骨/減価/声高/子女/食い違い/異に/突っ込ま

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: お祭りの、本気で、絶対、賑わい、絶対、警察、絶対、警備、絶対、対応、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The festival crowds kept us busy, and we did our best to manage security. Thank you for understanding.
lines.style: Professional, measured, even-paced. Slight formal dip at the start. Steady through the detail, landing warmly on the gratitude at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者の、本気で、絶対、背骨、絶対、損傷、絶対、警察、絶対、医師と、絶対、確認、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the victim's spinal injury was confirmed by both police and medical staff. That must have required careful coordination.
lines.style: Hesitant, genuinely concerned undertone. Slower pace on the medical detail. Trailing upward slightly on the confirmation, as if checking his understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。会社財産の、本気で、絶対、減価、絶対、偽装事件、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're also investigating what appears to be asset depreciation fraud connected to the company. The investigation is ongoing.
lines.style: Clipped, official. Each phrase lands with quiet precision. No rush, no inflection—just the facts, delivered with quiet competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者の、本気で、絶対、声高、絶対、な主張、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に、絶対、対応、絶対、されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand the suspect's been quite vocal about their version of events. You're handling that carefully, I take it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly impressed. Gentle inquiry—not interrogation. Brief pause before the question to show he's working through the implications.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被害者のお、本気で、絶対、子女、絶対、警察、絶対、保護、絶対、いたしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The victim's children are under protective care. That's one of our primary concerns right now.
lines.style: Shift to softer, slower delivery. The word 'children' carries weight—protection here is both procedural and human. Quieter closing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 証言の、本気で、絶対、食い違い、絶対、警察、絶対、整理、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And the conflicting accounts—you're working through those systematically.
lines.style: Quiet admiration in the tone. Asking more as acknowledgment than question. Thoughtful, slower pace. Slight exhale of relief at the competence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。各部署が、本気で、絶対、意見を、絶対、異に、絶対、する、絶対、点、絶対、警察、絶対、調整いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Different departments have different perspectives, but we coordinate across those divisions. It's part of the process.
lines.style: Calm, bureaucratic but honest. Steady throughout. No defensiveness—just explaining how the system works. Slight warmth on 'coordinate.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者、本気で、絶対、警察車両に、絶対、突っ込ま、絶対、れた、絶対、事件、絶対、警察、絶対、対応大変でしたよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That incident with the suspect ramming the police vehicle must have been harrowing. I can't imagine how taxing that was to handle.
lines.style: Soft, genuinely empathetic. Slower pace. Weight on 'harrowing.' Trailing off slightly—not asking for details, just acknowledging the difficulty. Quiet respect.
